descriptionEn: A house is offered for rent in Marigona Residence, near Prishtina.

The house is located in an elite, family-oriented neighbourhood, quiet and safe, with easy access to schools, markets and everyday services. The space has a living room, kitchen, two bedrooms, bathroom and WC, a green yard and reserved parking.

The property has a total area of 137m², is furnished in a modern style and ready to move into, with natural light in all rooms. It is suitable for long-term living, ideal for families or couples, and offers easy access to every part of the city.
